steps.title:
BODY 1  Motor body; the two 6702ZZ (orange) pressed into its hip-yaw seats from below
         (outer ring only; bearings go in before any servo)

BODY 2  Right hip-yaw servo straight down into its saddle;
         left one lifted ~10 mm, slid in from the side, then down
BODY 3  Ear screws (left front ear: M2x6 socket, ball-end key at 20-25 deg)

LEFT LEG 1 (before the bay)  6702ZZ pressed into the yaw connector (bench);
         yaw connector onto the hip-yaw horn and bearing; horn screw
LEFT LEG 2 (before the bay)  Hip-roll servo into the yaw connector, ear screws (an L-key)

RIGHT LEG 1 (before the bay)  6702ZZ pressed into the yaw connector (bench);
         yaw connector onto the hip-yaw horn and bearing; horn screw
RIGHT LEG 2 (before the bay)  Hip-roll servo into the yaw connector, ear screws (an L-key)

BAY 1  Bay enclosure onto the motor body (tongue under the deck);
   3x M2x10 countersunk UP from under the robot into the deck

BAY 2  Servo adapter: its 2 servo cables plugged in first,
   then it slides down into the rib slots (no screws)

BAY 3  IMU: Qwiic cable into its RIGHT socket; IMU straight down, then back
   onto the 4 pegs on the rear wall; a drop of hot glue on each peg tip (no screws)

BAY 4  Switch plate (built on the bench: M6 nut into its hex pocket,
   switch screwed in by turning its body, 3 wires soldered):
   down ~9.5 mm in from the wall, then out onto it - lever through the hole;
   2x M2x10 countersunk from outside

BAY 5  Battery 3S 60x30x20: hook-and-loop on the floor;
   leads + balance lead out of the rear-right window

BAY 6  XT30 pair into the rear cradle (1 zip tie),
   balance plug above the bay, mouth up

BAY 7  Mini560 (wires soldered from below)
   slides into the lid's rails, parts UP through the window

BAY 8  Lid onto the bay: 4x M2x6 socket into the posts
   (before the Uno Q: it covers them)

BAY 10 Camera USB: right-angle USB-C -> USB-A adapter, mouth DOWN;
   camera plug in from below, rear-left cradle, 1 zip tie
BAY 11 Uno Q cover (optional): 2x M2x6 through its sides

NECK 1  Both M3 nylon nuts into the cradle's pockets FIRST (the servos cover them),
        then the neck servo down into the cradle (on the bench), ear screws

NECK 2  Cradle onto the motor body's neck horn plate; horn screw;
        bearing plate from the other side (2x M2x6), M3x8 axle into its nut
NECK 3  Head-pitch servo down into the cradle, ear screws
HEAD 1  Head base; 6702ZZ pressed into its roll bulkhead; head-roll servo into its holder, ear screws

HEAD 2  6702ZZ pressed into the yaw block (bench); yaw block up through the floor opening
        ~4.8 mm forward, then back onto the roll horn; horn screw
HEAD 3  Head-yaw servo up into the yaw block, ear screws
HEAD 4  U onto the head-yaw horn and bearing; horn screw
HEAD 5  Jaw straight up through the two bill-plate slots; jaw pivot screw

HEAD 6  Beak servo: down ~4.5 mm toward the middle, then out onto the jaw arm;
        horn screw, ear screws

HEAD 7  2 M2 nuts into their pockets, the camera in from the front, the visor over it;
        3x M2x10 countersunk from the front (heads flush); then the face onto the head

HEAD 8  Dome last, straight down: 2 rear screws from below,
        2 front ones up through the jaw's holes

HEAD 9  Head (with the U) onto the head-pitch servo in the cradle; horn screw;
        bearing plate, M3x8 axle into its nut

LEFT LEG 3  Off the robot: 6702ZZ pressed into the thigh's hip-pitch seat;
         hip-pitch and knee servos into the thigh, ear screws

LEFT LEG 4  Knee: full horn in the shin's pocket, shin onto the spline, horn screw;
         6702ZZ into the shin's seat; cap down, 2x M2x6 (snug last)

LEFT LEG 5  M3 nylon nut into the shin's pocket first; ankle servo into the cradle, ear screws;
         foot onto the horn, horn screw; bearing plate from the other side, M3x8 axle into the nut
LEFT LEG 6  L-bracket onto the hip-pitch horn and bearing; horn screw
LEFT LEG 7  Hang the leg on the hip: L-bracket onto the hip-roll horn; horn screw
LEFT LEG 8  Thigh cover (optional), 2x M2x6

RIGHT LEG 3  Off the robot: 6702ZZ pressed into the thigh's hip-pitch seat;
         hip-pitch and knee servos into the thigh, ear screws

RIGHT LEG 4  Knee: full horn in the shin's pocket, shin onto the spline, horn screw;
         6702ZZ into the shin's seat; cap down, 2x M2x6 (snug last)

RIGHT LEG 5  M3 nylon nut into the shin's pocket first; ankle servo into the cradle, ear screws;
         foot onto the horn, horn screw; bearing plate from the other side, M3x8 axle into the nut
RIGHT LEG 6  L-bracket onto the hip-pitch horn and bearing; horn screw
RIGHT LEG 7  Hang the leg on the hip: L-bracket onto the hip-roll horn; horn screw
RIGHT LEG 8  Thigh cover (optional), 2x M2x6
WIRING  Servo leads, hubs and extension cables (sleeve + slack loop at the neck)
